t: This is Victoria Street, a street in the City of Westminster, named after Queen Victoria. She came to the throne in 1837 and reigned until 1901, longer than any monarch before her, and her reign gave its name to the Victorian era. Captain Roland Kitson, 3rd Baron Airedale, lived on this street. He was a businessman, born in Leeds, who lived from 1882 to 1958. He was the son of the first Baron Airedale, and his elder half-brother Albert became the second baron.
